```sql
SELECT 
    w.name AS warehouse_name,
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.sku,
    i.quantity_on_hand,
    i.reorder_level,
    -- Calculate total quantity sold for this product from this warehouse
    SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units_sold,
    -- Calculate total revenue generated by this product from this warehouse
    SUM(oi.total_price) AS total_revenue,
    -- Flag urgent restocks
    CASE 
        WHEN i.quantity_on_hand <= 0 THEN 'OUT OF STOCK'
        WHEN i.quantity_on_hand < i.reorder_level THEN 'URGENT REORDER'
        ELSE 'Healthy'
    END AS stock_status
FROM Warehouses w
JOIN Shipments s ON w.warehouse_id = s.warehouse_id
JOIN Orders o ON s.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN Order_Items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN Products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN Inventory i ON p.product_id = i.product_id AND w.warehouse_id = i.warehouse_id
WHERE 
    o.status = 'delivered' 
    AND o.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) -- Last 3 months only
GROUP BY 
    w.warehouse_id, p.product_id
HAVING 
    total_units_sold > 50 -- Filter for high velocity items only
ORDER BY 
    w.name, 
    stock_status ASC, -- Put "OUT OF STOCK" at the top
    total_revenue DESC;
```
